The source measured a natural Windham, Vermont specimen by electron microprobe. No composition-specific atomic-position refinement is reported, so atom\_sites is intentionally empty. The ambient lattice gives 321.7583 A^3, independently confirming the published EOS cell basis and V0=321.77 A^3.
